tracker.states_note: Linear states as of 2026-09-08, verified via list_issue_statuses: Triage, Backlog, Todo, In Discovery, In Handover, In Development (all three started), Done, Duplicate, Canceled. The canonical keys on the left are what skills and standards use; the values are the exact Linear names.
tracker.transitions_note: Only product-grill-with-docs moves discovery to ready-for-handover. Only handover-triage moves ready-for-handover to in-development or back to discovery with the label and a reason code.

engineering_team.note: Where handover-triage creates the engineering ticket. Conventions in ../beefcake-platform/docs/agents/issue-tracker.md. States are Linear defaults today; should mirror the mattpocock triage state machine.
